content:
Most Gurugram businesses that call us about SEO already have a website, a few blog posts and a vague sense that "nothing is happening". Usually the problem is not effort. The site is slow on mobile, service pages compete with each other for the same keywords, or the content is written for the owner rather than for the person searching. Our SEO work fixes those foundations first and then builds visibility for the searches that actually bring enquiries.

We are a Gurugram agency with an office on Sohna Road in Sector 49. Over 7+ years we have worked with 150+ clients on 500+ projects. Search in this city is crowded and varied, from SaaS teams in Cyber City competing nationally to clinics off Golf Course Extension Road competing for patients within a few kilometres, and each needs a different plan.

What SEO Work Actually Involves

"SEO" gets sold as a monthly package of backlinks and blog posts. In practice, organic search depends on three layers, and we work on them in this order:

  • Technical health: crawlability, indexing, site speed, Core Web Vitals on mobile, redirects, canonical tags, structured data and XML sitemaps. If Google cannot crawl and understand a page, nothing else matters.
  • Page and content relevance: one clear page per service or topic, written around what buyers actually search, with proper titles, headings, internal links and answers to real questions.
  • Authority: mentions and links from relevant sites such as industry associations, supplier and partner sites, local publications and genuine PR. We do not buy links from networks, because those tend to cause problems later.

For a B2B software company targeting buyers across India, most of the effort goes into content and authority. For a hospital or a coaching institute, the technical and page layers plus local signals usually matter more. The plan depends on the business, which is why we start with an audit instead of a package.

The First 12 Weeks, Step by Step

  1. Weeks 1-2: Audit and keyword mapping. We crawl the site, review Search Console data, check indexing and speed, and study which competitors rank for your key searches. You get a written audit and a keyword map that assigns each target search to one page.
  2. Weeks 3-5: Technical fixes. We fix or brief your developer on crawl errors, broken redirects, duplicate pages, slow templates and missing structured data. If we built your site, we make the changes ourselves.
  3. Weeks 5-8: Page rewrites and new pages. Existing service pages are rewritten or merged, and missing pages are created where the keyword map shows a gap. Each page gets a clear title, description and internal links.
  4. Weeks 8-12: Content and authority. We start publishing articles that answer buyer questions and begin outreach for relevant mentions and links.
  5. Week 12: Review. We compare impressions, clicks, rankings and enquiries against the baseline and agree the plan for the next quarter.

Technical fixes often show in Search Console within a few weeks. Ranking movement for competitive commercial searches usually takes several months, and we will say so upfront rather than promise page-one positions by a date.

What We Need From You

SEO moves faster when the client team is involved. Before we start, we ask for:

  • Admin or editor access to the website, plus hosting or developer contact if we did not build it
  • Owner access to Google Search Console and Google Analytics 4, or permission to set them up
  • A list of your most profitable services and the areas or customer types you want more of
  • Someone who can review content for accuracy within a few working days, especially for medical, legal or financial topics
  • Photos, project details and real FAQs from your sales or front-desk team

How We Report Progress

Every month you receive a short report and a call. We track numbers you can verify yourself in your own accounts:

  • Search Console impressions and clicks
  • Average position for mapped keywords
  • Indexed vs excluded pages
  • GA4 organic sessions
  • Form submissions and click-to-call events
  • WhatsApp button clicks
  • Core Web Vitals

Rankings are useful, but enquiries are what pay the bills. That is why we set up GA4 events for forms, calls and WhatsApp clicks in the first month, so organic traffic can be tied to leads rather than just visits.

Mistakes We Often See on Gurugram Websites

After auditing many local sites, a few patterns come up again and again:

  • Dozens of near-identical location pages: "service in Sector 45", "service in Sector 46" and so on, each with a swapped name. Google now treats these as low-value doorway pages, and they can drag down the whole site.
  • Heavy homepage sliders and uncompressed images: common on real estate and interior design sites. They look good on office Wi-Fi but load slowly on a phone in traffic on MG Road.
  • Blog posts with no link to a service page: traffic arrives, reads, and leaves without any path to enquire.
  • Changing domains or redesigning without redirects: years of rankings can disappear in a week.
  • Buying cheap backlink packages: these rarely help and can trigger manual actions.

When SEO Is the Wrong Choice

We would rather tell you now than take a retainer that will disappoint you. SEO is probably not the right first investment if:

  • You need leads this month for a launch or a limited-time offer. Paid ads are faster.
  • Your business is a single event or a short-term project with no ongoing demand.
  • You cannot give access to the website or approve content changes.
  • Your website is about to be rebuilt. In that case, plan SEO into the rebuild rather than optimizing a site that will be replaced.

For a steady business that wants enquiries that do not stop the day the ad budget runs out, organic search is worth the patience.

Frequently Asked Questions

How long before we see results from SEO?

Technical fixes and improved page titles can show changes in Search Console impressions within a few weeks. Meaningful growth in rankings and enquiries for competitive searches typically takes several months. The timeline depends on your site's current state and how competitive your industry is in Gurugram and beyond.

Do you guarantee first-page rankings?

No. Nobody controls Google's rankings, and agencies that guarantee positions are usually targeting keywords nobody searches. We commit to clear work, a documented plan and honest reporting from your own Search Console and GA4 data.

How much does SEO cost?

Cost depends on the size of your site, how much technical work is needed, how many services you want to rank for and how much content has to be written. We give a fixed monthly quote after a free audit, so you know exactly what is included.

We are in Udyog Vihar but sell across India. Is local SEO or regular SEO better for us?

If your customers are nationwide, you need regular SEO focused on topics and services, not on the city. Local SEO matters when customers come to you or you serve a defined area. Many businesses need a mix, and the audit will show which.

Can you work with our existing developer?

Yes. We share a prioritized list of technical fixes with clear instructions and check the changes after they go live. Many clients keep their developer and use us for SEO strategy, content and reporting.
